newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Serbia oil firm NIS Jan yr/yr sales 83pct up - paper.
newsitem.headline: Serbia oil firm NIS Jan yr/yr sales 83pct up - paper.

text.p: Serbia' oil company Naftna Industrija Srbije (NIS) marketed around 160,000 tonnes of oil derivatives in January, or 83 percent more than in the same month last year, Belgrade newspaper Politika said on Tuesday.
NIS sold 25,000 tonnes of petrol in January, or double sales in the same month a year ago, the paper said.
Lead-free and 86-octane petrol, as well as heating oil, registered the highest increase of nearly four times against last January's figures.
Compared to January 1996, fuel oil sales registered the lowest growth of 56 percent, the paper said.
No-one at NIS was immediately available to comment. -- Amra Kevic, Belgrade newsroom +381 11 222 4305
